game: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight
author: Universal Save Editor (community research)
description: RC4 key and field-location logic verified directly against the source code of the open-source DisLoPik/Lego-Batman-LOTDK-Save-Editor project (SaveEditor.py) — HIGH confidence on the key and on the 'StudsCollected' field specifically. This schema deliberately covers ONLY that one field: the same reference tool also edits WayneTech Chip / Bat Token unlock flags, but those use variable-length enum-string swaps with container-size patching, a materially riskier operation (can shift every following byte) that this engine does not yet support and was not worth the corruption risk to approximate. Not tested against a real captured save file by this project. Save format is Unreal Engine's GVAS serialized-property format: the whole file is RC4-encrypted at rest, decrypting to a file starting with the literal bytes 'GVAS'. Save path: %LOCALAPPDATA%/Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment/LEGO Batman Legacy of the Dark Knight/SaveGames/steam/<SteamID>/SaveSlot_0_TT.sav

fingerprints.description: The file has no recognizable plaintext header (it's encrypted at rest), so the only reliable fingerprint is: does RC4-decrypting with the known key reveal the GVAS magic?

fields.name: Studs Collected
fields.description: Located by searching for the GVAS property name rather than a fixed offset (property position varies between saves) — matches the verified reference save editor's logic: find the property name 'StudsCollected' (stored null-terminated in the real file; the trailing null isn't required for this search to land on the same position), then 'Int64Property' within ~45 bytes after it, then the value is 8 bytes starting 23 bytes after the start of that second match.
